description: Indicative full-charter price by aircraft size, one-way or return, in the local currency of the departure market: price range before taxes, estimated taxes, an all-in range, flight time and fuel stops, with the recommended size. Uses the same rates and rules as the altivojets.com calculator. An estimate, not a quote: the operator's quote confirms positioning, landing and handling.

currency.description: Optional 3-letter currency for an indicative conversion.

destination.description: Arrival city or airport, e.g. "Mumbai", "BOM", "VABB", "Teterboro" or "KTEB".

origin.description: Departure city or airport, e.g. "Mumbai", "BOM", "VABB", "Teterboro" or "KTEB".

return_date.description: Return date for a round trip, YYYY-MM-DD.
